domain_restrictions: u is arbitrary in the definition of the q-Pochhammer symbols.
k is a nonnegative integer in the q-Pochhammer product.
m is an integer in the q-bracket definition.
d and r are positive integers.
r is less than or equal to d.
q is treated as a formal indeterminate over Q.
The divisibility claim is inside the Laurent polynomial ring over Q in q, not merely inside the rational function field.
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: After defining the q-bracket, q-Pochhammer symbols, cyclotomic polynomial Phi_n, and the derived quantities U_{d,n}(q), T_{d,r,n}(q), R_{d,r,n}(q), G_{d,r,n}(q), and M_n(q), the statement says: for every positive integers d and r with gcd(d, r) equal to 1 and r less than or equal to d, and every integer n greater than 1 with n congruent to 1 modulo 2d, the Laurent polynomial G_{d,r,n}(q) is divisible by M_n(q) in Q[q,q^{-1}]. Equivalently, there exists a Laurent polynomial H_{d,r,n}(q) such that U_{d,n}(q) times (T_{d,r,n}(q) minus R_{d,r,n}(q)) equals M_n(q) times H_{d,r,n}(q).
quantifier_order: For each parameter u and each nonnegative integer k, the q-Pochhammer symbols are defined.
For all positive integers d and r with gcd(d, r) equal to 1 and r less than or equal to d, and for all integers n greater than 1 with n congruent to 1 modulo 2d,
there exists H_{d,r,n}(q) in the Laurent polynomial ring over Q such that U_{d,n}(q) times (T_{d,r,n}(q) minus R_{d,r,n}(q)) equals M_n(q) times H_{d,r,n}(q).

witness_dependencies: The witness H_{d,r,n}(q) depends on the specific parameters d, r, and n.
No witness uniform in d, r, and n is asserted.
The witness is for the specific expression U_{d,n}(q) times (T_{d,r,n}(q) minus R_{d,r,n}(q)).

statement_nl: Let [m]_q=(1-q^m)/(1-q). For any parameter u and integer k>=0, let (u;q)_k:=∏_{j=0}^{k-1}(1-u q^j), and let (u,v,w;q)_k:=(u;q)_k(v;q)_k(w;q)_k. Let Φ_n(q) be the nth cyclotomic polynomial, and define M_n(q):=[n]_q Φ_n(q)^2. Suppose d and r are positive integers with gcd(d,r)=1 and r <= d, and suppose n>1 satisfies n ≡ 1 mod 2d. Define U_{d,n}(q):=∏_{j=1}^{n-1}(1+q^{dj}), define T_{d,r,n}(q):=∑_{k=0}^{n-1} [3dk+r]_q (q^r,q^r,q^d;q^{2d})_k (q^d;q^d)_k^2 q^{k(d-dk-2r)/2}/(q^{2d};q^{2d})_k, define R_{d,r,n}(q):=[rn]_q q^{r(1-n)/2}, and define G_{d,r,n}(q):=U_{d,n}(q)(T_{d,r,n}(q)-R_{d,r,n}(q)). Then G_{d,r,n}(q) is divisible by M_n(q) in the Laurent polynomial ring Q[q,q^{-1}]. Equivalently, there exists H_{d,r,n}(q) in Q[q,q^{-1}] such that U_{d,n}(q)(T_{d,r,n}(q)-R_{d,r,n}(q))=M_n(q)H_{d,r,n}(q) in Q(q).
